contexts.text: The herb yielding seed (). When man is so prepared that he can receive heavenly seeds... the Lord causes... something more useful, which again seeds, and is called (as above); and at last something good, which is called the tree bearing fruit, in which is its seed...
That it is the Lord who sows; that the seed is His Word; and that the earth is man. Illustrated.
Fruit which is of love has seed, by which it multiplies itself.
Under Self, see this reference.
The herb yielding seed () = all truth which regards use.
Fruit = what the Lord gives to the celestial man; and seed from which is fruit, is what He gives to the spiritual man.
The seed of the serpent () = all infidelity; the seed of the woman = faith in the Lord. AC 254. AC 255, Explained, Illustrated.
Seed = what produces and is produced, or what begets and is begotten.
Seed = faith.
Not only faith is called the seed of the woman, but also the Lord Himself...

When man has been regenerated, he is called... ground, because heavenly seeds have been implanted in him... It is the external man, that is, its affection and memory, in which are implanted the seeds of good and truth; and not the internal man. Explained.

Thus celestial seeds were inseminated in them, and their descendants had in them seed from a celestial origin. Seed from a celestial origin is such that love rules the whole mind, and makes (the will and understanding) one mind...
With those in whom there is not celestial seed, but spiritual seed, as with... men now, there is no love... but faith is possible...
God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel () = that He gave another faith.
Then first can be inseminated celestial seeds, which are seeds of charity. The seeds of charity can never be sown in ground where falsities reign, but where truths do.
To vivify seed upon the faces of the whole earth () = the truths of faith; (for) by this Church seed was vivified: seed = faith.
This is like seed which is cast into the earth in winter time... So with spiritual seed...

Seedtime and harvest () = the man who is to be regenerated, and thence the Church, Man is compared, in the Word, to a field, thus to a seedtime, and the Word of the Lord to seed... It here treats of every man: that there will never be lacking to him the inseminating of seed by the Lord, whether he is within the Church, or without it... Without seed inseminated by the Lord, man cannot do a whit of good. All the good of charity, even with the gentiles, is seed from the Lord...

With your seed after you () = those who are being created anew... Seed, in the literal sense, = posterity; but, in the internal, faith; and as there is no faith except where there is charity, charity itself is meant by seed... wherever there is charity... there is seed; for celestial seed is charity.
The seed of God = faith, (that is to say) the charity from which is faith.
So the seed of Abraham, of Isaac, or of Jacob, = love, or charity. Explained.

Thus when seed is mentioned in the Word... by seed the Angels understand charity... And when the seed of Abraham, etc. is mentioned, they understand not their descendants, but all in the universe... with whom there is celestial seed, or charity; nay, the interior Angels perceive love itself, abstractedly, which is celestial seed. AC 1416:3. AC 1416:4.
That seed = love, and also every one who has love. Illustrated.
A seed of truth () = the charity, or faith of charity (of the Spiritual Church).
A seed of holiness... () = remains which are holy.
Those in His Kingdom, being regenerated from love, are called the seed of the blessed of Jehovah ().
The seed of the woman... a most ancient saying.

The celestial things of love (were) first imbued; thence, as from their seed, all things were fructified. The seed itself in Him was celestial... and He was the only one who had this seed... All men have no other seed than what is filthy and infernal... therefore unless they receive from the Lord new seed... they must be accursed to Hell.
To thy seed will I give this land () = that celestial things should be given those who would have faith... Seed = faith in the Lord. AC 1608.
Seed as the dust () = multiplication immeasurable.
As to the Human essence, He is called the seed of the woman.
To me Thou hast not given seed () = no internal to the Church. Seed = love and faith.
Seed as the sand () = good.
So shall thy seed be () = the heirs of the Lord's Kingdom. Seed = love and the derivative faith; or, what is the same, those in love and faith, both Angels and men. AC 1865.
Thy seed shall be a sojourner () = charity and faith rare.
All good and truth must be inseminated in freedom... there is no other soil in which the seed can grow.
I will multiply thy seed () = the fructification of the rational man... Seed = love and faith; here, to multiply seed = the fructification of the celestial things of love in the Rational...

With the man in good... the seed is not so multiplied by the Lord (here); but in the other life incredibly; for so long as man is (here) the seed is in corporeal soil... but when this is put off... the seed is set loose, and grows, as the seed of a tree is wont to do when it rises from the soil... For all knowledge, intelligence, and wisdom, and their delights... are thus multiplied... to eternity, from the smallest seed, as the Lord teaches of the grain of mustard.
Thy seed after thee () = those who have faith in Him. AC 2023. AC 2027. AC 2034. AC 2038. AC 2085.
Seed = the faith of charity. AC 2027. AC 2038. AC 2670. AC 2853.
A stranger not of thy seed () = those outside the Church.
Seed here = those who have the faith of love, that is, have love to the Lord, consequently the celestial... for it treats of seed from Isaac... AC 2666.
The good of charity is the very soil of the seeds of faith. AC 3324:2. AC 3324:4.
In Isaac shall seed be called to thee () = from the Divine Human is all salvation to those in good. AC 2670.
The spiritual also are seed, but from the son of the handmaid. Illustrated.
The good seed = truth.
The seed of Israel = the Spiritual of the Church, or the good and truth of faith.
Thy seed () = the spiritual who in the good of faith are saved by the Divine Human.
Seed = the faith of charity, or, those of the human race who are in it, that is, the spiritual; for these are called seed, and the sons of the kingdom, in .
Thy seed shall inherit the gate of thine enemies () = that charity and faith shall succeed in the place where before were evil and falsity. AC 3187.
In thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed () = the Salvation of all who are in good. AC 3380.
Good is what receives the truths of faith, which are called seeds. AC 3030:4.

To thy seed will I give this land () = the Divine truth pertaining to the Lord's Human. Seed = the faith of charity, and those in it; and, as all the good and truth of faith are from the Lord, it is the Divine truth itself which is meant by seed in the supreme sense.

Seed = those called the spiritual; thus, in a universal sense, all who constitute His Spiritual Kingdom, or this Kingdom itself; for seed = charity and faith, consequently those who are in charity through faith, who are the spiritual.
The seed () = the Lord's Word, thus the truth of faith.

Such as is the ground, such is the reception of the seeds, that is, of the truths of faith. Truths may be stored up in the memory, like seeds in a pod... but they do not become the man's until the ground has been prepared...
To thy seed () = truth... thus the truth which is from the Lord's Divine, which is thy seed.

In the internal sense, by seed is not meant any posterity from Isaac; but all who are the Lord's sons, thus the sons of His Kingdom, or, what is the same, those who are in the good and truth which are from the Lord; and, as these are seed, it follows that the good and truth itself from the Lord is seed; for thence are the sons; and therefore the truths themselves which are from the Lord are called the sons of the kingdom, in Matthew. He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man; the field is the world; the seed is the sons of the kingdom.
The seed of Abraham, etc... means all who are the Lord's seed, that is, who are in the good and truth of faith in Him.
That from the Lord alone is heavenly seed, that is, all good and truth. References.
I will multiply thy seed () = increase of truths. AC 3379. AC 3440.

Isaac sowed in that land () = interior truths appearing to the Rational... To sow, in the supreme sense, = the Divine truth which is from the Lord who is the sower; in the internal, the truth and good with man which is thence.

Unless the Spiritual from the Lord continually acted into their primitive forms which are in their seeds, they would never vegetate; but the forms there are such that they do not receive anything of life. It is from this influx that they have in them an image of the Eternal and the Infinite, as is evident from the fact that they are in the continual endeavour to propagate their kind... This is in every seed.
Seed = the good and truth of faith.

It is with good and truth as with seeds and soil: interior good is like seed which produces, but not except in good soil: exterior good and truth is like the soil in which it is produced: the seed, which is interior good and truth, can in no other way be rooted. Hence it is that the Rational must be regenerated first of all and then the Natural, in order to serve as soil...

Perceptions of good and truth thence are like seeds... scientifics and works are like the soil; and, when man is affected with scientifics which confirm good and truth... the seeds there are as in their soil, and grow...
Their goods and truths in the Church are called the seed which God chose ().
Seed = the truth of faith. AC 3710.
Thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth () = that Divine truth natural should be as natural good. Seed = truth, hence the seed of Jacob = Divine truth natural.

Like seeds, which are more perfect within than without... The external forms thence produced can be easily injured; but not so the inmosts of the seeds, which are in a more interior and perfect nature.
The seeds sown in a field = things which are of good and truth.
Thy seed as the sand of the sea () = fructification and multiplication... Seed = the faith of charity, and also charity itself.
Would be like casting seed into water or sand.

To thy seed after thee I will give the land () = to Divine truth Divine good appropriated. Seed = the truth of faith; in the supreme sense Divine truth... (Thus) to thy seed after thee = Divine truth appropriated to Him...
To carry a casting of seed () = instruction in truths.
Raise up seed to thy brother () = lest the Church perish. Seed = truth from good, or the faith of charity.
For seed is the truth of faith, and conception is reception.

Such are afterwards received into... the province of the seminal vesicles. For in the vesicles is collected the seed with a suitable serum with which it is combined, and by the combination is rendered fit so that after it has been emitted it is resolved in the neck of the uterus, and thus serves for conception; and there is in such a substance a conatus and as it were longing to perform use, and thus to put off the serum with which it is invested. Representation. AC 8847:2. SE 875. SE 884.
It is a fallacy... that from the first creation there has been impressed on seeds the reality of growing. AC 5116:3.
Seeds () = Divine truths.
The seed of the land () = the truth of the Church. AE 281:2.
The seed of peace () = good in the interior man. ( = remains: those who are in truths of good. AC 5897:7.)
The man of the Celestial Church is regenerated by... seed implanted in the Voluntary; but the man of the Spiritual Church, by seed implanted in the Intellectual.
Man when reborn, also begins from seed; and therefore by seed, in the Word, is signified the truth which is from good.
A representation of the eternal and infinite in seeds. LJ 13:2. DLW 60. DLW 318, Described. DP 56:3. TCR 32:3, Described.
Seed = the truths which are of faith from charity.
Jacob and all his seed with him () = natural truth and all the things of faith belonging thereto... Seed = the faith of charity. AC 6022.
Before (adult age) the good of love and truth of faith fall like seed into barren ground.
Give seed () = influx of the good of charity and truth of faith.
Lo seed for you, and ye shall sow the ground () = the good of charity and truth of faith which were to be implanted. Seed = truth from good, thus both.
For seed of the field () = for the nourishment of the mind. Seed = truth and good, thus faith and charity.
I will give this land to thy seed () = the Lord's Kingdom to those in this good and truth. Seed = the truth of faith and the good of charity.
God hath made me see thy seed () = ... the good and truth thence.
His seed shall be a fulness of nations () = that the truth which is of faith shall reign. Seed = faith and charity; here, faith, because it is predicated of Ephraim.
Good is the soil; truths are the seeds.
But seeds, barley, wheat, and the like, = interior truths and goods.
Seeds, in the Word, = truths and goods.
This is represented (there) as a tree... its leaves are truths; its fruits are the goods of truth; its seeds are goods themselves, from which are all the rest.
Man is compared to a tree... and its seeds from which are new trees, to truths which are from good, or to the faith which is from charity.
Man is called a field because he receives the truths of faith, which are seeds, and produces the fruits of the seeds, which are goods.
Like coriander seed, white () = the truth therein that it was pure. Seed = the truth of faith.

Still more interior (in fruits) are the seeds, which are encompassed with cases, and the seeds themselves with membranes; and underneath these is the interior flesh (or pulp), in which is the first form, like a soul, from which again come new trees... The first form, which is the inmost one in the seed... must be successively opened...

This is like the germ in the seed of a fruit; all the fibres (of which) look to this germ, which they nourish and form by the percolating sap; but after it has been formed, the fibres retreat, and convey the sap from the seed. Then the pulp of the fruit rots, and serves the germ for soil; and the case is the same with the seed itself... The germ in plants corresponds to the good in man; the seed itself to the internal things; and the pulp of the fruit around the seed, to the external things. (The correspondence of this with regeneration.) This is meant by: the Kingdom of the heavens is like a grain of mustard... which is the least of all seeds...
Seed = the truth of faith. References.
To sow = to instruct.
The seeds which are sown in a field = the truths of faith which are implanted in good.
Good seed () = truths of faith from the Lord. ( = Divine truth. AC 9807:8.)
Seed of Sihor () = scientific truth.

Seeds are in a more perfect state than the pulp outside them; (for) when the pulp rots, the seeds remain entire. So in the seeds - the germ within them is in a more perfect state than the parts outside it...
The seed of man () = truth of faith from proprium; thus truth falsified and adulterated by application to evils from a looking to self and the world. ( = the truth of the Word. AR 913:end. CL 79.)
The inmosts of a seed (are in a degree discrete from) its exteriors.
To him and to his seed, to their generations () = all who receive the things which proceed from the Lord, thus who are being regenerated by Him. Seed = those who are born from the Lord...
The seed of Aaron, in special, = those in the Celestial Kingdom; and generations, those in the Spiritual Kingdom.
That seed, sons, etc. = those who are in love and faith in the Lord; and, in the abstract, the goods of love and truths of faith. Illustrated.
Seed of man () = the internal good of these Churches; seed of beast, their external good. AE 280:7. (Compare AE 433:25. AE 768:4.)
Seed of David = those who have been regenerated by the Lord; and, in the abstract, those things with them which are from the Lord, which are the truths of faith and the goods of charity.

Seed = those who are regenerate, thus those who are of the Church; in the abstract, the things which make a regenerate man, or which make the Church with man, which are faith and charity from the Lord.
Seed, in the opposite, = those who are against the things of the Church, thus who are in evils and falsities; and, in the abstract, evils and falsities. Illustrated.
I will multiply your seed as the stars () = goods and truths, and their Knowledges.
Seed, when predicated of Heaven and the Church, = the good and truth there. AC 10446.
I will give it to thy seed () = to those who are in the good of love and truths of faith from the Lord.
Foods, especially those from the seeds of harvest, correspond to affections of good and truth...
Natural heat... merely disposes seeds into their natural forms, by expanding and opening them, in order that the influx from the Spiritual World may act as the cause (of vegetation) there.
A tree extracts... the purest sap for its seeds.

Truth is meant by seed in a field (in the parable of the sower). The sower = the Lord; the seed = His Word, thus the Truth: the seed upon the way = with those who do not care for Truth; the seed upon the stony places = with those who care for Truth, but not for its own sake, thus not interiorly; the seed in the midst of thorns = with those who are in the concupiscences of evil; and the seed in good ground = with those who love the Truths which are in the Word from the Lord, and do them from Him, thus the fruits.
That the Divine is in each and all things of the universe actually... may be seen from the wonderful faculty which is in every seed. Described.

For as soon as a seed falls into the bosom of the earth, it cherishes it, and from all sides gives from itself resources, in order that it may germinate, and present itself in a form representative of man.

Unless there were such a pre-eminent perfection in prior and simple things, neither man nor animal could come forth, and afterwards subsist, from seed; nor could the seeds of trees and shrubs vegetate; for the more prior and simple a thing is, because it is more perfect, the more exempt it is from injury.
There is a like (simultaneous) order of discrete degrees in every seed.

For the seed which is from the father is the first receptacle of life, but such a one as it was with the father; for it is in the form of his love, and the love of everyone is like itself in the greatests and in the leasts, and there is in it a conatus into the human form...

That there is such a conatus... in the substances and matters of earths, is evident from the fact that seeds of every kind, opened by means of heat even to their inmost, are impregnated by the most subtle substances and by this are in the power of conjoining themselves with use, from which is their Prolific, and then, by conjunction with matters from a natural origin, are in power to produce their forms, and then send them forth as from a womb, that they may come into the light, and thus germinate forth and grow.
The first production from these earths, when they were still recent, and in their simplicity, was the production of seeds. The first conatus in them could not be anything else.
The primes (of plants) are seeds... and, through the bark, which is the ultimate of the stems, they tend to seeds...
In all their progression there is the end of producing fruits and seeds, which are uses.
The heat, light, and atmospheres of the natura world only open seeds, keep their productions in expansion, and induce matters on them, which fix them; bit this not by forces from their own sun...

(So in the animal kingdom) a body is formed from seed introduced into a womb or ovum, which body is the ultimate of the seed; and this body... produces new seeds. (The parallel with the vegetable kingdom.)
The Prolific is not from the seed, nor from the sun... but is in the seed from God the Creator...
An adulterer commingles his life with that of the husband; for a man's life is in his seed.
The seed of the woman = the Lord.

In the seed is the soul; for impregnation is effected by it; and it is that which is clothed with a body by the mother. The seed is the first form of the dove in which the father is: it is the form of his reigning love with the proximate derivations, which are the inmost affections of that love. TCR 92.
(This conversion can only be done by) eradicating evil from its seed, and implanting good seed instead thereof.
Like the Prolific in a seed, which accompanies it within even to new seed.
The procreations of wisdom from love are like seeds...
The remnant of her seed () = ... novitiates who receive...
The seed of the woman, here, = those who are of the New Church and are in the truths of its doctrine. Illustrated. AE 768, Illustrated.
By the seeds (of a tree) are signified the ultimates and primes of man.
Semination corresponds to the power of truth.

Love and wisdom together with use... propagate man; for in the seed of a man is his soul in a perfect human form, covered over with substances from the purest things of nature, from which (substances) is formed a body in the womb.

Virile semination is from a spiritual origin... being from the truths of which the understanding consists... Nothing is received by males from the spiritual marriage... except truth, and that which relates to truth; and this, in its progress into the body is formed into seed; and hence it is that seeds, spiritually understood, are truths.

The masculine soul is truth... and therefore when the soul descends, truth descends... and, when this takes place, the entire soul forms itself, and clothes itself, and becomes seed; and this can be done thousands and thousands of times, because the soul is a spiritual substance. Explained.

Hence the soul (in spite of conjugial disjunction) is still procreated, but in the descent, when it becomes seed, it is veiled over with such things as are of his natural love. From this springs hereditary evil.
The protection of seeds by shells (is analogous to the love of infants).
(Otherwise) all the noble seed of the Church would be turned into ignoble seed; as the seed of an olive into the seed of a pine, etc.
For in the seed of everyone... there is a graft or offset of the soul of the father, in its fulness, within a certain envelope of elements from nature: by these its body is formed in the womb...
That there is such an infinity of spiritual seeds, or of Truths, in the Word. Explained.
Faith without Truths, is like seed bereaved of its medullary substance...
Like one who scatters seed... and does not harrow it in...
Faith is (then) like barren seed...
In the seed of a tree lies hidden as it were the end, intention, and purpose to produce fruits: in these things the seed corresponds to the will...
Unless there were spiritual substances together with the material ones, no seed could be impregnated from the inmosts, and grow...
From this sphere about every particle of earth the inmost of each seed is impregnated, and the Prolific vegetates. Explained. TCR 585:end. TCR 785:2. SE 1847.
The seed of man is conceived interiorly in the understanding, and is formed in the will, and is thence transferred into the testes, where it clothes itself with a natural covering...
On seeds. WE 1009. WE 1011.
On the insemination and rooting of the seeds of faith.
The seeds are innumerable... but the universal and one only seed, in which all the rest are ordinated... is that the Lord alone rides the universe...
For everything is like a seed from which grows a tree.
I have sometimes perceived the odour of human seed: it is from those who relate to the seminal vesicles, and to the spermatic vessels.
When I was collecting seeds, the angelic Spirits thought about the last times, when the good seeds should be separated from the evil. So in all other things.
The seed dispersed on all sides through the body, is received by the soul which is in the whole body, thus in the fibres and vessels on all sides, and then deliciates the wife...
What is purest of touch causes that the interiors, which are the seed, are excited. Explained.
The seed sown in a field are the sons of the kingdom = the truths from good from the Lord with man. AE 48:2.
The seed of man = the Divine truth which is in the Word. AE 237:end. AE 411:4. AE 1029:5.
The seed of David = those in truths from good from the Lord; or, truths from good.
Seed = truth. AE 600:12. AE 740:6.

The good seed in a field = the truths of the Church which are from good: to sow = to inflow and receive, thus to instruct; the man who sowed = the Lord by the Word where are all the truths of the Church.
The seeds truths from the Word, or those which man receives from the Lord.
Seed from Jacob = the Knowledges of good and truth.
Their seed = all of that Church.
The good seed = the good.
Seed = charity and faith.
To sow... = to reform...
The seed of the field = the truth of the Word.
Seed = the truth of the Word.
Seed = the truth of doctrine. AE 768:12. AE 768:19. AE 768:21. AE 768:23.
Seed of peace = the truth of the Church which... protects against the Hells...
His seed () = infernal falsity. AE 768:23. AE 768:24.
The seed of evil-doers () = direful falsity of evil.
Seed given to Molech = such infernal falsity.
The man sewing good seed in his field = the Lord as to Divine truth, which is the Word, in the Church... To sow tares = to insinuate and implant falsities.

That adultery is Hell... everyone may conceive from the commixture of diverse seeds in the womb of one woman. Man's seed is that in which lies hidden the inmost of his life, and thence the beginning of a new one, which, from this, is holy... LJPost 341. DeConj 37.
But in chaste marriages the man's life through the seed adds itself to that of the wife. Hence an inmost conjunction, from which they become one flesh...
The rain of thy seed () = the multiplication of truth.
Plants resemble the animal kingdom in that they come forth from seed...
It matters not that continuations (of creation) are effected by seeds: it is still the same creative force which produces. Angelic Idea.

In the inmost Heaven there are fruits and seeds of pure gold; in the middle one of silver; and in the lowest one of copper... All these are growths from the earths there... But nothing is produced there from seed sown, but from seed created; and creation there is instantaneous...
2. Nothing in nature comes forth except from seed...
5. Seed is the first of a tree... and it returns to (seed)... Seed also is the first of an animal... and, when it matures, it has seed in it.
The man's seed, as to its Spiritual, and also as to its interior Natural, adds itself to the body of the woman...

Trinity. 4. 4. The Divine truth, which is the Word, in which is the Divine good, was the seed from the Father, from which the Human was conceived. From the seed is the soul, and through the soul is the body.
Trinity. 4. 5. The spiritual origin of all human seed is truth from good.
6. There is not a single object in the mineral kingdom which does not give out an odour, and, indeed, in the form of an impalpable powder, by which seeds are impregnated.
